definitions.gloss: special order; custom order; made-to-order item
definitions.explanation: An item ordered with custom specifications, different from the standard product. Common in retail, fashion, and manufacturing.

examples.japanese: この{色|いろ}は{別注|べっちゅう}{品|ひん}です。
examples.english: This color is a special-order item.

examples.japanese: {別注|べっちゅう}モデルは{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}です。
examples.english: The custom model is available in limited quantities.

examples.japanese: あのセレクトショップが{有名|ゆうめい}ブランドに{別注|べっちゅう}をかけた{限定|げんてい}コレクションが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: The limited collection that boutique commissioned from a famous brand is popular.

notes:
Commonly encountered in fashion and retail, where shops commission exclusive colorways or designs from brands. The compound uses {別|べつ} (separate, special) + {注|ちゅう} (order, abbreviation of {注文|ちゅうもん}). Often used as a modifier: {別注|べっちゅう}{品|ひん} (custom item).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別注|べっちゅう}{品|ひん}: special-order item
- {別注|べっちゅう}モデル: custom model
- {別注|べっちゅう}をかける: to place a special order (with a manufacturer)
- {別注|べっちゅう}カラー: exclusive colorway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特注|とくちゅう}: custom-made, bespoke (very close synonym; slightly more emphasis on unique specification)
- オーダーメイド: made-to-order (loanword, more for individual custom items)
- {受注|じゅちゅう}{生産|せいさん}: made-to-order production
